en: At Pentecost, tongues of what rested on each disciple?

en: Which tax collector climbed a tree in Jericho to see Jesus?

ko: 물 위를 걸어 예수님께 간 제자는 누구입니까?

ko: 돌아온 탕자를 달려가 껴안은 사람은 누구입니까?

en: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see whom?
